text: ボックスに　あずけとる　ポケモンを　つれて　いけるで

structure.jp: ボックスに　あずけとる　ポケモンを
structure.en: Pokémon you have deposited in the Box
you can take along, you know

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is the western-Japan dialect form of ている, which says the result is still there. あずけとる = 'have deposited'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ボックスに　あずけとる　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. ボックスに　あずけとる　ポケモン = 'Pokémon you have deposited in the Box'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing いく to いける turns 'go' into 'can go'; the で at the end is dialect for よ. つれて　いける = 'can take along'.
